name: Label Print Request
description: Print queue + audit trail for finished-kit labels. One row is created automatically when a Work Order enters 'In Process' (see playground.playground.label_printing). A local print agent polls for Status = Pending rows over the REST API, prints TSPL to the TSC printer, and sets Status = Printed / Failed. Never blocks the Work Order.

fields.label: Work Order
fields.description: The Work Order that triggered this label request.

fields.label: Status
fields.description: Pending: waiting for the print agent. Printed: sent to the printer. Failed: see Error Log; use Reprint to retry.

fields.label: Description
fields.description: Item description (HTML stripped), printed on the label.

fields.label: Company
fields.description: Printed on the label as the company name.

fields.label: Batch No
fields.description: Optional - included on the label if the Work Order carries a batch.

fields.label: Number of Labels
fields.description: Work Order Qty x Item's Labels Per Unit.

fields.label: Label Template
fields.description: Name of the TSPL template the print agent renders (e.g. KIT_LABEL).

fields.label: Error Log
fields.description: Populated by the print agent when a print job fails.
